## Implementation Summary

**Status: INTEGRATION MECHANISM DELIVERED AND DOCUMENTED — NOT APPLIED TO ANY TARGET PROJECT**

The Shared Workbench Project Integration capability is implemented in the repository and was inspected for this report:

1. **Adapter script** (`scripts/workbench-adapter.js`): Generates a project-scoped `.opencode.json` for a target directory, registering all seven Workbench agents via `system: {file:<ABS>/agents/<name>.md}`. Orchestrator runs in `primary` mode; all six specialists run in `subagent` mode. Seven stages: (1) validate Workbench root contains all seven agent files; (2) canonicalize each agent path and enforce containment within `agents/`; (3) refuse to overwrite an existing `<target>/.opencode.json` unless `--force`; (4) generate config with deny-* baseline plus ask rules (Developer/QA shell/edit) and Reporter edit restricted to `reports/*`; (5) back up any pre-existing config to `<target>/.workbench-backups/<timestamp>/` with a SHA-256 manifest; (6) idempotent re-runs exit cleanly without `--force`; (7) rollback restores byte-for-byte only after hash verification.
2. **Test suite** (`tests/workbench-adapter.test.js`): Six test cases covering symlink-escape containment rejection, argument parsing (missing target, unknown flag, `--force` overwrite), idempotency, backup SHA-256 generation/manifest verification, rollback abort on missing hash, and timestamp uniqueness. Zero npm dependencies; uses only Node built-ins; cleans up temp directories; exits nonzero on failure.
3. **Root configuration** (`opencode.json`): Seven agents registered with deny-* baseline (`deny *:*`, allow read/glob/grep, deny `*.env*` read, deny `external_directory`), agent-specific rules, and `{file:}` system references. Verified structurally by inspection.
4. **Project-context template** (`projects/project-context-template.json`): Nine descriptive fields (identity, tech_stack, architectural_constraints, dev_test_commands, production_safety_boundaries, approved_file_modification_scope, existing_skills, reporting_destination, human_approval_requirements) for capturing per-project integration context.
5. **Documentation** (`AGENTS.md` "Project-Scoped Workbench Integration" section): Describes adapter usage, behavior, and boundaries; notes that generated configs contain machine-specific absolute paths that are not committed to the app repo.
6. **CI** (`.github/workflows/validation.yml`): Runs `node tests/validate.js` on push/PR to `chore/opencode-v2-integration` and `main` on ubuntu-latest and windows-latest with Node 22, least-privilege `contents: read`.

No target project has been configured: no `.opencode.json` exists outside the Workbench root, and no `.workbench-backups` directory exists anywhere in the repository.
